notes: Ethereum mainnet launch of Swarmlings (LING), an 18-decimal DN404 token with constructor (), and SwarmlingsHook with constructor (IPoolManager manager, address token), resolved as ($poolManager, $token). The hook requires a CREATE2 address with its low 14 bits all set (0x3fff), matching all 14 declared permissions. beforeInitialize and afterInitialize accept calls only from the PoolManager and return their callback selectors. afterInitialize binds the first LING / IMD pool at static LP fee 12500 as the launch pool. This pool uses tick spacing 60. initialPrice is the reference sqrtPriceX96 value 2^96; the deployer derives the opening price from the separate launch policy cap of 2,500 IMD and token address ordering. Supply and allocations, including the requested poolBps 9000, are governed by that policy, not this manifest. The token constructor creates SwarmlingsMirror. Each whole 300,000 LING corresponds to one NFT, with at most 3,333 NFTs. A transfer that would mint more than 800 NFTs automatically enables skipNFT for its receiver. The token and mirror have no administrative owner powers or upgrade mechanism; owner() is a marketplace label only. The hook starts with no slices or modules. Its initial configuration authority is SwarmlingsCouncil at 0x4d0b3507d80f678d9e658fd5482ca6a96636a032, already deployed and owned by the DEV wallet 0x92cef4823119f3332a85a39023eeba01a06890c4 as specified in the brief. Council execution applies immediately and logs a memo. Only the current council can configure slices and modules or replace council authority; the council owner is transferable. The fixed holder fee is 1.25% in IMD on buys and sells in every LING / IMD pool using the hook once the launch pool is bound, in addition to the pool LP fee. The configurable hook fee, including the holder floor, slices and quoted extras, is capped at 5%. A separate launch buy tax falls linearly from 40% to zero over 60 seconds after initialization, goes entirely to holders and sits outside that cap; sells are exempt. Module guards cannot veto sells or liquidity removal. The hook records its deploying factory as launcher and exempts that factory from the JIT fee penalty. NFT sales carry a 5% ERC-2981 creator fee, split equally between holders in ETH and the fixed DEV wallet. Rewards arriving on one UTC day stream during the next day per NFT and per second held. Anyone may call distribute(), syncEth(), syncToken(), addRewards() and a deployed sink's poke(); claim(), claimEth() and claimToken() pay only the caller's rewards, and claimDev() pays only DEV. Hook BUILD_TAG and vendored DN404 balance/totalSupply storage remain unchanged; test/HookSalt.t.sol and test/DealProbe.t.sol guard launcher compatibility. This manifest covers the contract launch; the site follows separately using live deployment addresses.
